configs.colour_accuracy: lc (leading colour): one program per (process, colour flow)

kernels.name: k0

library.call: int k0(double *mem, const symjit_slice *states, size_t idx, const double *params), symjit_slice = {double *ptr; size_t len}: states = the input planes (the binding's inputs, in order) then the output planes (re, im of each output pair); k0(NULL, states, i, params) reads point i of each input plane and writes point i of each output plane; 0 on success. See the header

kernels.format: a symjit plane application (.plane.symjit: the MIR of one executor row, f64); inputs and outputs as the bindings list them, each output a (re, im) pair
